question: Which of the following is NOT a globally shared digital resource ?
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3). i.e. "Automobile".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Knowledge, Design, and Software are mentioned as examples of globally shared digital resources in the passage. (paragraph 1)
 
• Automobile is not mentioned as a digital resource; it is a physical product.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Automobile".**
